primary_paper.title: Sums and Differences of Finite Sets
primary_paper.location: Section 2, equations (13), (14), and (15), projection paragraph immediately following (15).
primary_paper.finite_construction: V(m,L)={(x_1,...,x_m) in nonnegative integers: sum x_i<=L}; |V|=C(m+L,m); |2V|=C(m+2L,m); |V-V|=sum_{k=0}^m C(m,k)^2 C(L+m-k,m). The projection weights are L_0=1 and L_{j+1}=2L L_j+1.
primary_paper.scope_note: The finite m=6,L=5 projected set is a feasible witness for this task. Asymptotic exponents discussed elsewhere in the paper are different statements and are not reported as the value of this finite objective.

task_objective.note: Finite objective from this exact witness; it is not the paper's separate asymptotic exponent.

objective_distinction_from_t012.ordering: T012 ranks A above B, while T077 ranks B above A. Both sets satisfy the T012 size and interval limits and the T012 checker preconditions.

open_status.evidence: The paper gives the general finite construction, including this locally instantiated m=7,L=4 set, and asymptotic results, but no maximum for the benchmark finite domain.
open_status.limitation: The formula witness is a reproduced traditional construction, not a proof that its objective is maximal.

stronger_reconstruction.source: Same published general finite projection formula in Section 2, equations (13)-(15), instantiated locally at m=7,L=4; this is not a standalone numerical record stated in the paper.
stronger_reconstruction.translation_note: Translation preserves |A+A| and |A-A| cardinalities; centering the projection makes it satisfy the symmetric integer interval.
stronger_reconstruction.role: best reproduced result derived from a public formula; not separately reported by the paper
